title: OGraf — Making Broadcast Graphics Open and Accessible
speaker: Niels Borg (TV 2 Danmark) & Paola Sunna (EBU)
summary: OGraf's dedicated conference session at IBC 2026, part of the Owner & Partners Programme and SMPTE's "Future of Media Infrastructure" roadshow day. How designing once and playing anywhere works in practice, and what it means for vendors and production teams.

title: OGraf showcase at IBC 2026 — EBU stand 10.D21
summary: OGraf runs from a dedicated demo pod on the EBU stand across all four days, showing one package travelling from creation to live and on to post: CBC and Adobe/StreamShapers coming out of After Effects, Everviz animated maps, TV 2 Danmark on DaVinci Resolve for non-linear, SPX Graphics on touchscreen and Unreal Engine, plus Loopic, Erizos and LiveOS. The EBU stand also hosts the Open Source Meetup (Sat 12 Sep, 16:00).

title: Open Graphics for Live Media: OGraf Proven in a National Election
speaker: Niels Borg, TV 2 Danmark
summary: The first big production case study: TV 2 Danmark ran OGraf graphics through its national election coverage, letting the anchor walk through results interactively. Slides available as PDF from the EBU.

title: OGraf Explained: Open, Interoperable Broadcast Graphics
location: Streaming Tech Sweden 2026 · Hotel At Six, Stockholm · 10:05
speaker: Niels Borg (TV 2 Danmark) & Tuomo Kulomaa (SPX Graphics)
summary: OGraf's first appearance at a streaming-side conference rather than a broadcast one — why vendor-neutral graphics workflows matter, pitched to an audience of players, DRM, ad-tech and live-production people.

title: SMPTE VIBE: OGraf — Making Broadcast Graphics Open and Interoperable
location: NAB Show 2026, Las Vegas · Room N259 · 2:20–2:35 p.m. PDT
speaker: Willem Vermost, EBU
summary: OGraf's NAB debut, in SMPTE's VIBE conference track: how an OGraf graphic is structured, how the Control API works, and what the spec changes for broadcast graphics workflows.

title: OGraf at MediaTech Festival 2026
summary: The OGraf working group took the standard to Odense with a joint presentation and the launch of the OGraf explainer video led by the BBC. HTML graphics ran through the whole festival: the BBC made the case on stage and SPX Graphics called 2026 the biggest year yet for the technology.
speaker: Ben Sheppard & Ryan MacKenna (BBC) with Niels Borg (TV 2 Danmark)

title: OGraf demo at EBU Production Technology Seminar 2026
speaker: Niels Borg, TV 2 Danmark
summary: A hands-on OGraf demo running through PTS, built from templates contributed by the working group. Not a programme session — it lived on the floor, which is why it doesn't show up in the published agenda.

title: OGraf — Open HTML standard for broadcast graphics · Open Source Meetup, IBC 2025
speaker: Niels Borg, TV 2 Danmark
summary: Niels Borg's OGraf pitch at the EBU Open Source Meetup — how the open specification for HTML graphics in live TV and post came together, days before the v1 Graphics spec was published.

title: OGraf showcase at IBC 2025 — EBU stand 10.D21
summary: The show where OGraf went public. Demonstrated on the EBU stand as "specification and implementations that facilitate use and management of on-screen graphics across platforms," with Loopic, SPX Graphics and coralbay.tv running OGraf on their own stands. The v1 Graphics specification was published days later, on 17 Sep 2025.

title: OGraf: A new HTML standard — EBU Network Technology Seminar 2025
speaker: Niels Borg, TV 2 Danmark
summary: Technical deep-dive presentation at the EBU Network Technology Seminar covering OGraf's architecture, manifest format, and server API direction.

title: HTML graphics in broadcast applications with EBU's OGraf spec
summary: The spec's first session open to everyone, industry included, after the members-only preview in March. A technical overview of the draft's features and OGraf's role in practical broadcast applications. Slides and recording are on the EBU site.

title: EBU's Open Standard for HTML Graphics in the Broadcast Industry
summary: The first outing for the draft spec, presented to EBU Members only. The open-to-industry version followed a month later — this is where the HTML graphics specification that became OGraf was first shown outside the working group.

title: Accelerator Kickstart Day 2025 — Evolution of the Control Room wins Project of the Year
summary: The IBC Accelerator project carrying the HTML-based graphics workstream — the one that fed into OGraf — was named Project of the Year at Kickstart Day, hosted by the BBC. Public recognition for the work weeks before the first OGraf roundtable.

title: Evolution of the Control Room — IBC 2024 Accelerator
summary: Pre-OGraf context: the IBC Accelerator project championed by TRANSMIXR, ITN, the BBC and TV 2 Danmark, whose second R&D stream — modular, cross-vendor HTML-based graphics, with SPX Graphics taking part — helped seed the case for an open standard.
